alloy: all u: Axiom | (some v: Unit | cites[u, v] and v not in Axiom) implies u in Misnesting
doubt: Finding kinds (Misnesting etc.) are read as sets: u in Misnesting means checker reports a misnesting for u, since Finding is in Thing (not disjoint from Unit).

(all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Extend.rel implies d2->d1 in Context.rel) and (all a, b, c: Document | (a->b in Extend.rel and b->c in Extend.rel) implies c->a in Context.rel)
doubt: Read 'is context for it' literally (the extending document is context for the one it extends), and read 'transitive through extension' as: extending through a two-step chain of extends also makes the outer document context for the far end. Direction and exact scope of the transitivity clause are my best guess.

all f: Unterminated | f in Refused

some owner_1, owner_2: Owner, failing_cleanup_1: Failing | owner_1.handler = owner_2 and eventually (dispose[owner_1] and failing_cleanup_1.on = owner_1 and after eventually (runNow[failing_cleanup_1] and after eventually failing_cleanup_1.reached = owner_2))
doubt: Read the two 'then' connectives as strict sequencing (after eventually), and 'while failing_cleanup_1 is on it' as holding at the same moment as the dispose event.
